القدرة على استخدام أدوات تحليل وتصميم العمليات.
التعرف على مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية (KPIs) وتطبيقها.
اكتساب المهارات العملية في الحوكمة وإدارة المخاطر والامتثال.
التمكن من تطوير مهارات تحليل وتقييم المخاطر.
تطبيق مفاهيم الحوكمة والتوافق مع التشريعات.
تطبيق مفاهيم استمرارية الأعمال.
features: ربط المعرفة العلمية والمهارات ربط واضح بالقدرات العملية عبر مناقشة حالات واقعية في الشركات العالمية والمحلية في المملكة العربية السعودية
العمل على تطوير سياسات وضوابط لحالات واقعية والقيام بتقييم مخاطر سيبرانية لقضايا حقيقية والقيام بتقييم إلزام لسيناريوهات واقعية.
تصميم حلول عملية مبتكرة لمواجهة التحديات التقنية في بيئات العمل الحقيقية.
تعزيز التعاون والعمل الجماعي من خلال مشاريع مشتركة بين الفرق المختلفة.
تطبيق أفضل الممارسات العالمية والمحلية في مجال الأمن السيبراني وحوكمة التقنية.
متابعة وتحليل أحدث الاتجاهات والتقنيات لتعزيز القدرة على اتخاذ قرارات استراتيجية فعّالة.
توجيه وإرشاد من خبراء تقنيين لضمان اكتساب المهارات بالشكل الأمثل.
ورش عمل تفاعلية وحلقات نقاش مع مختصين.
requirements: أن يكون المتقدم سعودي الجنسية.
جهاز لابتوب شخصي.
يجب  أن يكون المتقدم حاصل على شهادة البكالوريوس في تخصص تقني.
يلزم اجتياز اختبار القبول للإنضمام للمعسكر.

events.title: Global Forum on the Ethics of AI (GFEAI)
events.summary: Riyadh is hosting the 4th UNESCO Global Forum on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence (GFEAI 2026) from 14–17 September 2026, co-hosted by the Saudi Data and AI Authority (SDAIA) and UNESCO, in collaboration with the International Center for AI Research and Ethics (ICAIRE). The forum will bring together ministers, policymakers, AI experts, international organisations, and researchers to advance global dialogue on the ethical development, governance, and responsible use of artificial intelligence, while marking the fifth anniversary of UNESCO's Recommendation on the Ethics of AI. Saudi Arabia's hosting of the forum coincides with the designation of 2026 as the Year of Artificial Intelligence and the Global AI Summit 2026 , organised by SDAIA in Riyadh from 15–17 September 2026 under the patronage of His Royal Highness Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Crown Prince, Prime Minister, and Chairman of SDAIA's Board of Directors, reinforcing Riyadh's position as a global centre for international AI dialogue, policy, and innovation.

Saudi Arabia's hosting of the forum coincides with the designation of 2026 as the Year of Artificial Intelligence and the Global AI Summit 2026 , organised by SDAIA in Riyadh from 15–17 September 2026 under the patronage of His Royal Highness Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Crown Prince, Prime Minister, and Chairman of SDAIA's Board of Directors, reinforcing Riyadh's position as a global centre for international AI dialogue, policy, and innovation.

events.summary: Whether you are new to art or want to deepen your knowledge and enjoyment, the Art of Looking at Art welcomes everyone on a five-day introductory journey designed to deepen the way participants view, understand, and experience art. Through foundational learning, exhibition visits, reflective writing, group critique, discussions on Arab and global art, and direct engagement with a practicing artist, participants will develop a more confident, personal, and informed relationship with art. The course blends observation, emotion, cultural context, and critical thinking, guiding each participant toward discovering their own unique way of seeing. Alongside the exhibition floor, the Elite Lounge serves as the heart of the Tawasul Meetings—a premium space where top buyers meet top brands and conversations turn into real business impact. events.title: ICEGOV – International Conference on Electronic Governance
events.organizer: Digital Government Authority | United Nations University | Prince Sultan University
events.summary: Riyadh hosts the 19th edition of the International Conference on Theory and Practice of Electronic Governance (ICEGOV 2026) from September 28 to October 1, 2026, under the patronage of the Digital Government Authority. Organized by the United Nations University in collaboration with Prince Sultan University, the conference brings together over 700 specialists from 60 countries. Held under the theme “Strengthening Digital Governance through Innovation, Human-Centered and Trustworthy Services,” the event explores key topics such as digital trust, artificial intelligence, smart cities, and the future of government services, reinforcing Riyadh’s role as a hub for global dialogue and innovation in digital governance.

events.summary: The E3 Customer Experience Conference (6th Edition) takes place in Riyadh on 29–30 September 2026, bringing together leaders and practitioners to shape the next generation of customer experience in Saudi Arabia’s fast-growing market. Supported by Tajriba and the National CX Academy Saudi Arabia, the event spotlights how AI, digital transformation, and analytics are redefining customer interactions in line with Vision 2030, with sessions covering customer journey mapping, omnichannel strategies, personalisation, brand experience, and emerging technologies. events.summary: The Saudi International Falcons and Hunting Exhibition is one of the largest events dedicated to falconry and hunting in Saudi and globally. It brings together everything related to falconry and outdoor excursions, from falcons and hunting tools to equipment and gear associated with hunting trips, all within a comprehensive space that allows visitors to explore this field in one place. The exhibition also features platforms showcasing a wide range of brands, alongside accompanying activities and events suitable for families, creating an experience that blends cultural and entertainment elements. The event plays an important role in preserving falconry heritage and raising awareness by offering content that introduces visitors to its history and significance within Saudi’s cultural identity.

events.title: Saudi Falcons & Hunting Exhibition
events.summary: International Saudi Falcons and Hunting Exhibition 2026 takes place from October 1 to 10 at the Riyadh Exhibitions and Conferences Center in Malham, bringing together one of the world’s largest events dedicated to falconry heritage, hunting, and outdoor pursuits. Organized by the Saudi Falcons Club, the exhibition reflects the Kingdom’s commitment to preserving national heritage and strengthening its global position in falconry. events.title: Saudi Falcons Club Auction
events.summary: The Saudi Falcons Club organizes an annual auction dedicated to locally caught falcons, known as “Al Tarh falcons,” which are captured during the hunting season. The auction is a structured platform that brings falconers together to showcase their falcons in a competitive live bidding environment, enabling reliable buying and selling. The event is broadcast on television channels and digital platforms. The club also provides integrated services for falcon owners, including transportation to the auction venue, along with facilities that organize and enhance the participation experience, all within a framework aimed at developing falcon auctions in Saudi. The auction also contributes to raising awareness about preserving falcon breeds by regulating sales and emphasizing the protection of endangered species.

events.title: Melwah Falcon Racing
events.venue: Saudi Falcons Club in Malham - Riyadh
events.venue_address: Saudi Falcons Club in Malham - Riyadh
events.summary: Melwah Racing 2026 takes place from October 4 to 9, bringing together falconers and enthusiasts for one of the Kingdom’s most anticipated falconry competitions. Organized by the Saudi Falcons Club, the event celebrates a traditional sport deeply rooted in Saudi heritage while supporting the Kingdom’s position as a global hub for falconry. Held on an expansive field, the race tests the speed, agility, and training of competing falcons. Birds are released from the arms of their handlers and fly toward a lure operator positioned 200 meters away, with the fastest recorded times determining the winners across multiple categories. Featuring financial prizes and prestigious titles, Melwah Racing highlights the close bond between falconer and bird, while promoting public interest in this historic tradition.

events.title: Global CSR Forum
events.summary: Under the patronage of the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Riyadh will host the Global CSR Forum on 5–6 October, organized by the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development, bringing together ministers, decision-makers, experts, private-sector leaders, and international organizations to explore the latest global developments in corporate social responsibility, share best practices, and spotlight innovative solutions that support the UN Sustainable Development Goals. Building on the momentum of its inaugural edition, the forum serves as a platform for cross-sector dialogue and partnership—connecting government, private, and non-profit stakeholders—while showcasing leading local and international CSR and sustainability initiatives and strengthening Saudi Arabia’s growing leadership in social responsibility.

events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra

events.title: Global Space Connectivity and Sustainability Events
events.summary: The Communications, Space and Technology Commission (CST), in partnership with the International Telecommunication Union (ITU), is hosting the Global Space Connectivity and Sustainability Events in Riyadh under the theme "Connected World, Sustainable Space." The event brings together the third editions of the Global Forum on Connecting the World from the Skies and the Space Sustainability Forum, creating a global platform to advance innovation in non-terrestrial networks (NTN) and promote the sustainable use of space. It will convene policymakers, regulators, industry leaders, researchers, and technology experts to discuss the future of space communications, integrated terrestrial and non-terrestrial connectivity, space sustainability, and emerging opportunities in the global space economy. The three-day programme will feature keynote sessions, panel discussions, technical presentations, and the announcement of the winners of the third NTN International Research Competition, highlighting the latest developments in space communications, international collaboration, and sustainable space technologies.

events.title: The Soul of Place: Leveraging Folklore and Local Heritage in Narrative Writing
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.summary: This interactive course offers a comprehensive introduction and explanation for participating short story writers and novelists on the methods of drawing inspiration from folklore and folk heritage. It covers the construction of spatial settings, their utilization within the novel and how to artistically leverage the potential of folk heritage as a means to add authenticity to writing, enhance identity and make the writer portray their environment and culture. This interactive course will enable the supervisor to assist participants in completing their novel projects throughout the duration of the course and producing an integrated and successful narrative project. events.title: World Stadiums and Arenas Summit
events.summary: The World Stadiums and Arenas Summit—the region’s largest stadiums and sports facilities conference and exhibition—returns to Riyadh at Hilton Riyadh Hotel & Residences. This flagship gathering brings together global leaders, architects, developers, government stakeholders, and sports federations to showcase cutting-edge technologies, sustainable design solutions, and best practices in building and upgrading stadiums and sports venues. With Saudi Vision 2030 driving major investment in sports and entertainment infrastructure, the summit offers a front-row view of the latest industry trends—from smart stadiums to eco-friendly facilities—and how they are shaping the future of sport in the Kingdom and beyond. Register Now World Sports 360 Summit | Athlete 360 Co-located with the World Stadiums and Arenas Summit, World Sports 360 Summit | Athlete 360, brings together global experts, elite athletes, coaches, and industry leaders to shape the future of sports, wellness, and human performance in the Kingdom. Focused on integrating performance and health, the programme spotlights cutting-edge performance optimisation (recovery, data-driven training, and advanced technology), holistic athlete development (nutrition, sports medicine, mental resilience, and long-term wellbeing), and the evolving Saudi sports landscape powered by Vision 2030. Expect practical insights, knowledge exchange, and forward-looking discussions spanning the sports economy, club management, revenue strategies, talent development and scouting, and the latest innovations in athlete technology and performance. Register Now The programme also features the World Stadiums and Arenas Awards , celebrating standout achievements in stadium and arena development across 10 categories highlighting innovation, sustainability, and exceptional project delivery—including architectural design for new venues, renovation and modernisation, innovative materials, multi-use design, creative lighting, eco-friendly architecture, community and social impact, safety and security leadership, accessibility and inclusivity initiatives, and the People’s Choice Award for outstanding stadium design.

Building on its flagship event in Cannes, MIPIM Middle East launches in Riyadh on 20–21 October 2026 as a 100% B2B platform focused on the region’s fast-paced growth and investment opportunities in sustainable urban development—bringing together international capital, policymakers, and leading developers through curated networking, strategic conference programming, premium showcases, and qualified one-to-one meetings, alongside exclusive Riyadh project tours to spotlight the Kingdom’s most significant developments. Register Now

events.title: Global Health Exhibition
events.summary: Global Health Exhibition 2026 takes place in Riyadh on 26–29 October 2026 at the Riyadh Exhibition and Convention Center (Malham) under the theme “Invest in Health,” bringing together global healthcare leaders, decision-makers, investors, and innovators to shape the next era of health. The event spotlights the trends and partnerships accelerating digital transformation and new models of care—from AI in clinical practice and digital health to workforce evolution and breakthrough medical technologies—through a major exhibition and multi-stage conference programme. Key stages include the Leaders Summit, Medical Excellence Forum, Digital Health Forum, and Investor x Venture Forum, offering attendees real-world insights, networking, and opportunities to explore a more integrated, tech-driven healthcare ecosystem. The exhibition offers structured opportunities to connect with key decision-makers—bringing together distributors, trade buyers, project owners, consultants, architectural engineers, and specifiers to source products and explore innovative solutions from industry professionals and suppliers. Key showcase areas include interior design and finishing, construction and building materials, Stone Tech, PMV (plants, heavy machinery and vehicles), wood and production technologies, construction technologies and services, special construction services, and aluminium, doors, facades, glass and windows. events.title: Esports Nations Cup
events.organizer: Saudi Esports Federation || Esports World Cup Foundation
events.summary: The Esports Nations Cup (ENC) debuts in Riyadh in November 2026, bringing national-team esports to the global calendar in a structured, recurring format where players compete under their country’s flag and fans rally behind national pride. As a nation-based complement to club competitions, ENC is built through local partnerships with national esports bodies and wider stakeholders to strengthen grassroots ecosystems, and will feature only top-tier titles selected in collaboration with confirmed publishers including Chess.com, MOONTON Games, SNK, Electronic Arts, Krafton, and Ubisoft. National Team Partner applications are now open to help countries lead team selection and operations on the road to ENC 2026, with the tournament launching as part of a four-week esports festival in Riyadh before adopting a rotating host-city model for future editions and returning every two years. Buy Tickets

events.title: Saudi Statistics Forum
events.summary: The Second Saudi Statistics Forum is a high-level national platform organized by the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT) to strengthen cooperation, promote statistical integration, support capacity development, and facilitate knowledge exchange across the Kingdom's statistical ecosystem. Building on the success of its inaugural edition held in April 2025, the second edition will be held under the theme "Towards an Integrated Statistical Ecosystem" on 9 November 2026 in Riyadh, alongside the 6th United Nations World Data Forum 2026. The Forum is expected to bring together Their Highnesses, Excellencies, ministers, representatives of international organizations and statistical offices, local and international experts, decision-makers, and academics. It will feature specialized sessions and an accompanying exhibition with broad participation from local and international organizations. The Forum aims to raise awareness of the role of official statistics in policymaking and national development, strengthen partnerships between national and international statistical entities, and promote knowledge sharing to support a more integrated and sustainable statistical ecosystem. Register Now Initiative: Road to Riyadh (R2R) As part of the preparations for the 6th United Nations World Data Forum 2026, the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT) launched the "Road to Riyadh" program to promote awareness of the Kingdom's role in data and statistics and support knowledge exchange and international collaboration. The initiative featured a series of in-person and virtual sessions, seminars, and workshops held across several cities in the Kingdom throughout the year. The program reflects GASTAT's ongoing efforts to strengthen the Kingdom's position in the statistical field and support the development of data and statistical systems in line with the Sustainable Development Goals and Saudi Vision 2030. The Second Saudi Statistics Forum is a key "Road to Riyadh" event.

events.title: 6th United Nations World Data Forum 2026
events.summary: The 6th United Nations World Data Forum (UNWDF 2026) is taking place in Riyadh, bringing together representatives from governments, international organizations, academia, civil society, national statistical offices, and the private sector to discuss the future of data and its role in supporting policymaking and advancing the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Established by the United Nations in 2017, the UN World Data Forum is a high-level international platform dedicated to advancing data and statistics in response to global developments. It highlights the importance of statistical indicators in informing decision-making, shaping public policies, and supporting economic and sustainable development planning. Saudi Arabia's hosting of the sixth edition reflects the Kingdom's commitment to advancing international cooperation, strengthening strategic partnerships in data and statistics, and supporting the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030. The forum will provide an international platform for knowledge exchange, sharing best practices, fostering innovation in data, and strengthening collaboration among stakeholders from around the world. events.title: Pet & Vet Expo
events.summary: Saudi Arabia’s pet industry has experienced remarkable growth in recent years, driven by a rising number of pet owners and increasing demand for high-quality products and services tailored to animal care. As household incomes grow and the middle class expands, pet owners are becoming more discerning in their choice of premium food, accessories, and veterinary services. Now in its fourth consecutive year, Saudi Pet Expo reflects the strength and potential of this rapidly developing market. The Kingdom’s pet care market is valued at approximately SAR 5.1 billion, with an annual growth rate exceeding 9%. Saudi Arabia also imports pet and bird food from 18 countries worldwide, highlighting the sector’s global integration and expanding opportunities for industry stakeholders. Register Now

events.title: Cat Show
events.summary: The International Cat Show 2026 returns to Saudi Arabia for its third edition, taking place at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center, as part of the Saudi Pet & Vet Expo. Organized by the World Cat Federation (WCF) in collaboration with Cattus Invictus Kedvencek Magyar Egyesülete (KET), the event brings together breeders, cat enthusiasts, and international judges for a professional competition atmosphere. Participants will be evaluated according to WCF-certified standards, including breed, color, and age, with judging criteria covering body structure, head, ears, eyes, and coat. Visitors can look forward to discovering exceptional feline breeds and witnessing the crowning of the event’s King and Queen of Cats in one of the Kingdom’s most distinguished pet events. Buy Tickets

events.title: Saudi Drone Exhibition SADEX
events.organizer: Digital Image for exhibitions and conferences
events.summary: Saudi Drone Exhibition SADEX 2026 takes place in Riyadh on 9–11 November 2026, bringing together the full drone and Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) ecosystem—manufacturers, regulators, investors, operators, and end users—under one roof to power the next generation of unmanned aviation. Across a three-day exhibition and conference, the event showcases cutting-edge advances in smart aerial mobility, autonomous logistics, AI integration, and communications, while offering tailored matchmaking that connects exhibitors with decision-makers, government buyers, mega-project leaders, and industry executives to unlock partnerships and new business opportunities. With international participation from 20+ countries, SADEX is positioned as a key platform for collaboration, investment, and technology exchange accelerating UAS adoption across Saudi Arabia’s growth sectors. Register Now MAVEX 2026 (Marine Autonomous Vehicles Exhibition) Running alongside SADEX 2026, MAVEX 2026 is Saudi Arabia’s landmark exhibition dedicated to unmanned maritime systems—including USVs, UUVs, and ROVs—showcasing the latest in autonomous maritime and naval technologies. Leveraging the Kingdom’s strategic coastal geography, MAVEX highlights innovation across ports operations, naval protection, offshore oil, marine ecology, intelligent logistics, leisure navigation, and aquaculture, positioning Riyadh as a meeting point for maritime autonomy and next-generation ocean solutions. SAUDI UGV 2026 (Unmanned Ground Vehicles Exhibition) Also co-located with SADEX 2026, SAUDI UGV 2026 debuts as the Kingdom’s dedicated platform for Unmanned Ground Vehicles, spotlighting breakthroughs in robotics, artificial intelligence, and autonomous mobility. Designed to drive innovation and cross-sector collaboration, the exhibition focuses on real-world operational needs across homeland security, energy, logistics, and industrial applications, connecting solution providers with stakeholders shaping the future of ground autonomy in Saudi Arabia.

events.venue_address: King Abdulaziz Falconry Festival, Malham - Riyadh
events.summary: King Abdulaziz Falconry Festival returns from November 17 to 30, bringing together falconers from Saudi Arabia and around the world. Organized by the Saudi Falcons Club, the festival stands as one of the Kingdom’s leading heritage events, celebrating the deep-rooted tradition of falconry in the Arabian Peninsula. With prize money exceeding SAR 38 million, the event highlights the Kingdom’s commitment to preserving national heritage, raising public awareness of falconry traditions, and reinforcing Saudi Arabia’s position as a global hub for falconry in line with Vision 2030.

events.title: General Aviation Airshow — AERO Middle East x Sand & Fun
events.summary: Riyadh will host AERO Middle East x Sand & Fun 2026 from 24–28 November at Thumamah Airport, organized by the Saudi Aviation Club in partnership with Messe Frankfurt Saudi Arabia. Set to be the largest general aviation event in the Middle East, the exhibition will unite leading global manufacturers, avionics and navigation providers, and MRO companies, covering the full aviation value chain. The event will also spotlight startups in advanced air mobility and eVTOL technologies, alongside live flying displays and interactive public experiences. Supporting the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030, the exhibition reinforces the Kingdom’s ambition to become a global hub for general aviation and innovation in future air mobility. Register Now

events.title: Global Logistics Forum
events.organizer: Ministry of Transport and Logistics Services | Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani)
events.venue: King Abdulaziz International Conference Center, Riyadh
events.venue_address: King Abdulaziz International Conference Center, Riyadh
events.summary: Under the patronage of the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques, Riyadh will host the Global Logistics Forum (GLF) alongside UNCTAD Global Supply Chain Forum (GSCF) from November 29 to December 1, 2026. The two forums bring together global leaders, policymakers, and industry experts to shape the future of logistics and supply chains, reinforcing Saudi Arabia’s position as a leading global logistics hub connecting three continents. Aligned with Saudi Vision 2030 and the National Transport and Logistics Strategy, the forums provide an international platform to strengthen partnerships, enhance sector competitiveness, foster innovation, and promote resilient, efficient, and sustainable global supply chains in the face of evolving geopolitical, economic, environmental, and technological challenges.

events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.summary: Filmmakers, photographers, cinematographers and actors are welcomed to join us for a seven-day filmmaking course under the supervision of Jaan Al-Balushi. Nearly 20 participants will come to Ithra every day from 4 to 9 p.m. to cover the stages of filmmaking, starting from the idea and scriptwriting, filming, and, finally, to editing. Editing equipment, such as the Adobe Premiere software, will be available. At the end of the course, three individual teams will each produce a short film ranging between two to seven minutes. Course Objectives: Gaining a comprehensive understanding of short films, including their history, genres and techniques Developing critical thinking and analytical skills

events.title: Future Projects Forum
events.summary: The 8th Global Future Projects Forum and Exhibition 2026, organized by the Saudi Contractors Authority, will take place in Riyadh from December 7 to 10 at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center. The event brings together contractors, stakeholders, and project owners from both the public and private sectors, offering a global platform to explore upcoming projects, understand application procedures, and engage with key industry leaders. Featuring a comprehensive program that includes the main forum, an international exhibition, contracting excellence awards, a finance conference, and the annual meeting of the Confederation of International Contractors Association, the forum is expected to host over 400 local and international entities. It aims to enhance transparency, foster partnerships, support sector growth, and promote knowledge exchange in line with Saudi Vision 2030, while creating valuable networking opportunities across the construction and projects ecosystem. events.title: Arabic Calligraphy × Woodworks: From Script to Object
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.summary: This workshop explores the transformation of Arabic calligraphy from a written system into a constructed wooden object. Participants engage with letterforms as structural elements rather than decorative motifs, translating them into physical compositions through a process that combines sketching, digital vectorization and fabrication. Course Objectives: Understand the structural logic of Arabic calligraphy beyond visual aesthetics Explore the relationship between language and material Develop the ability to translate two dimensional script into physical objects Learn the fundamentals of vector design for fabrication Gain awareness of wood properties and fabrication constraints Course Outcome

events.organizer: Organising Committee of AIMAG || Olympic Council of Asia

events.title: BIO Middle East (BIOME)
events.venue: Riyadh Exhibition and Convention Centre, Malham
events.venue_address: Riyadh Exhibition and Convention Centre, Malham
events.summary: Taking place alongside CPHI Middle East 2026, BIO Middle East serves as a specialized biotechnology platform that complements the region’s largest pharmaceutical gathering. While CPHI brings together the full pharmaceutical value chain, BIO Middle East focuses on advanced biotechnology, strategic partnerships, and life sciences innovation. As the region’s pioneering platform for strategic networking and high-impact public-private collaboration, the event connects global and regional leaders through the partneringONE platform, enabling curated meetings that foster partnerships, licensing opportunities, and investment deals. Co-located with CPHI Middle East, BIO Middle East features a focused agenda covering cell and gene therapies, mRNA technologies, next-generation vaccines, and biomanufacturing — offering a unique blend of scientific insight and commercial opportunity that drives biotech growth across Saudi Arabia and the wider region. Register Now Together, the two events create a comprehensive industry ecosystem — uniting pharma manufacturing, biotech innovation, investment, and research — and reinforcing Saudi Arabia’s growing role as a regional and global hub for healthcare and life sciences.

events.organizer: PNG KSA  ||  Search On Media Group
events.summary: From 14 to 16 December 2026, Riyadh will host Saudi Makes Future, the Kingdom’s premier innovation, culture, and education expo, inspired by the global We Make Future, the International Trade Fair on AI, Tech and Digital Innovation. Organized by PNG KSA in partnership with Search On Media Group, this landmark event will bring together entrepreneurs, innovators, educators, policymakers, and cultural leaders from across the world to explore the future of artificial intelligence, digital innovation, sustainability, and creative industries. With a rich program of talks, panels, startup competitions, and exhibitions, the event will serve as a catalyst for creativity, collaboration, and investment, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030 and reinforcing Riyadh’s role as a regional and global hub for technology and the knowledge economy.

events.title: Content Creation for Conversational Podcasts
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.summary: This specialized training course focuses on the fundamentals of talk podcasting, explaining why it is a rapidly growing platform with seven million listeners in Saudi Arabia and 180% annual growth and how it achieves an 80% audience retention rate. The course covers podcast types, how to build a general theme, identify target audiences using the Customer Persona model and highlights the research skills needed to create valuable content and select successful guests. It also details content creation skills, such as transforming gathered information into broadcast ready materials: including questions, media and descriptions, while mastering guest introductions, attractive titles and professiona

events.title: AlUla Trail Race
events.organizer: Royal Commission for AlUla / Experience AlUla
events.summary: Every January, AlUla bursts into action with the AlUla Trail Race - a dynamic celebration of endurance and unity set against its breathtaking ancient landscape. Whether you’re tackling the ultra-marathon or cheering on the Kids Run, each course challenges the spirit while weaving through awe-inspiring heritage sites and sandstone wonders. This multi-day event invites runners and supporters alike to come together, creating memories that blend athletic grit with cultural discovery. Expect vibrant energy, international camaraderie, and a festival-like atmosphere the whole family can enjoy.

events.summary: The 24th ERRA Annual Conference takes place in Riyadh from February 1 to 3, bringing together international regulators, experts, and industry leaders to discuss the future of electricity sector governance and transformation. Hosted by the Saudi Electricity Regulatory Authority (SERA), the conference is held under the theme “From Oversight to Foresight: The Proactive Regulator in the Electricity Transformation.” The conference explores forward-looking regulatory approaches, innovation in electricity markets, consumer protection, and evolving energy systems. It also reflects Riyadh’s growing role as a destination for major international forums and supports the Kingdom’s wider ambitions in energy leadership and sustainable development. Registration

events.title: Human Capability Initiative Conference
events.venue: King Abdulaziz International Conference Center (KAICC), Riyadh
events.venue_address: King Abdulaziz International Conference Center (KAICC), Riyadh
events.summary: Under the patronage of His Royal Highness Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Crown Prince, Prime Minister, and Chairman of the Human Capability Development Program (HCDP) Committee, the third edition of the Human Capability Initiative (HCI) Conference—one of the Saudi Vision 2030 Realization Programs—will take place on April 12–13, 2027, at the King Abdulaziz International Conference Center in Riyadh under the theme “The Human Code.” The conference will focus on three pillars: deep human connection, sound reasoning amid complexity, and value-driven creation to safeguard human contribution and purpose in the age of accelerated technological advancement. HCI 2027 aims to attract more than 15,000 visitors and over 250 local and international speakers, including policymakers, thought leaders, and experts from government, private, nonprofit, and global institutions, providing a platform to exchange best practices and showcase inspiring global success stories. The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland will participate as Country of Honor, reflecting the strength of the Saudi-British strategic partnership in advancing human capability development. Building on the success of previous editions—which welcomed over 23,000 visitors, featured 550+ speakers, and announced more than 156 launches and agreements—the conference reinforces the Kingdom’s commitment to investing in human potential as a foundation for sustainable growth and global competitiveness in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030.
